name: Veyron Proyect
description: Frame-based macro recording and playback, live HUD, VPR import/export, and input timing analysis for Geometry Dash.

hud-enabled.name: Enable gameplay HUD
hud-enabled.description: Show the Veyron live status panel while playing.

hud-position.name: HUD position
hud-position.description: Choose one of the four screen corners.

hud-scale.name: HUD scale
hud-scale.description: Size of the live status panel.

audio-enabled.name: Enable chimes
audio-enabled.description: Play a short tone on captured and replayed press inputs. The pitch follows the interval between presses, not a measured hitbox window.

master-volume.name: Chime volume
master-volume.description: Amplitude of generated Veyron WAV chimes.

safe-mode.name: Safe playback mode
safe-mode.description: Require Practice Mode before injecting a macro into gameplay.

auto-save.name: Auto-save on stop/reset/quit
auto-save.description: Write the captured macro to the configured VPR path when a recording ends.

macro-file.name: VPR macro file
macro-file.description: The same path is used by the Load VPR and Save VPR buttons.
